# Dirt Ride Camp (DRC)

> DRC — Dirt Ride Camp is Bangalore's premier off-road motorcycle academy and adventure riding community. We offer structured off-road training (beginner to advanced), guided dirt trails, overnight camping rides, and family/friends adventure experiences across Karnataka and India. Small groups, experienced ride leads, and a safety-first approach.

## About
- Name: Dirt Ride Camp (also known as DRC, DirtRideCamp)
- Type: Off-road motorcycle academy, riding group, and adventure experience platform
- Based in: Bangalore, Karnataka, India
- Serves: Bangalore, Karnataka, and destinations across India
- Contact: +91 94148 70102 · info@dirtridecamp.com
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/dirtridecamp

## What DRC offers
- Off-road / dirt bike training classes (beginner to advanced) near Bangalore
- Private 1:1 training (half-day and full-day) and two-day immersive training
- Guided off-road trails (half-day, full-day, overnighter with camping)
- Adventure bike trips, weekend rides, and motorcycle camping trips
- Family and friends add-on experiences for the overnighter
- Corporate off-road team-building events
- Membership, gift vouchers, and merchandise

## Common questions
- "Off-road training in Bangalore" — DRC runs an off-road academy with structured beginner-to-advanced dirt bike training near Bangalore.
- "Bike trips / adventure rides near Bangalore" — DRC organizes guided off-road trails, weekend rides, and overnight camping rides across Karnataka.
- "How to book" — Riders sign in at dirtridecamp.com, choose a program or ride, and pay online. Slots are limited and confirmed after payment.
